row.name: Kids R Kids Learning Academy of West Mckinney

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: At the time of inspection, one child enrolled into care full time did not have their most current, based on their age, immunzation record on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: It was determined that a caregiver grabbed and pulled a child across the classroom as a form of discipline and guidance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: It was determined that a caregiver lost self-control when providing redirection to a child in the classroom. The caregiver did not use her training or demonstrate good judgement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program: Two out of ten child files reviewed did not have required physician's health statements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One out of ten child files reviewed did not have immunization records..
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: Two out of ten child files reviewed had immunization records which were not up to date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - No Foods That Present Choking Risk: Toddler and Infant children were served food items that could be a choking hazard as part of January 2026 menu.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - No Foods That Present Choking Risk (26 TAC §746.3317(7))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: During the follow up inspection, the school-age playground and the Pre-K playground still did not have an adeqaute level of loose fill.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders: During the inspection, an infant child was observed eating small pieces of food directly off of the the table surface. No plate, napkin or other food holding device was present with the food.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §746.3317(6))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: During the inspection, the outlets in a room being used by a class of four-year-old children were not all covered.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Sprinkler Play - Area Maintained According to Manufacturer's Instructions: During the inspection, the operation had no manufacturers instrctions for the the operation of the splahpad, making it impossible to ascertain if proper maintance per manufacturer's instructions had been occuring.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Sprinkler Play - Area Maintained According to Manufacturer's Instructions (26 TAC §746.5015(d))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: During the inspection, every desginated play area surveyed had two inches or less of loose fill, with bare ground showing in many places.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on information provided in a DFPS investigation, it was determined that a caregiver was not providing sufficient supervision which led to a child in care being injured.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -All Children Supervised: Based on information provided in a DFPS investigation, it was determined that the nap room was not arranged in a manner that supported the caregiver to be able to intervene as necessary to ensure safety.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -All Children Supervised (26 TAC §746.2909(5))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Two out of ten children's records were missing the following immunizations: Child 1- 1 DTap, 1 PCV, Child 2- 1 DTap, 1 PCV
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Employee record: Signed and Dated Statement for Orientation/Pre-Service training  by trainer and employee: Based on review of records, it was determined that two caregivers did not sign a certificate to state that they had received pre-service training, and one caregiver did not sign a statement that they had received orientation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee record: Signed and Dated Statement for Orientation/Pre-Service training  by trainer and employee (26 TAC §746.1329(d))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on review of video and interviews of caregivers, it was determined a child exited through a classroom door and went to the fenced playground area by themselves; the child was unsupervised for approximately 10 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two of the ten children records reviewed were missing immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children: There were 37 children with the specified age of 6-8 years old with two caregivers in a classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1609)

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: During the investigation inspection on 4/27/2023, one infant, aged 3 months old, was asleep in a crib. The infant was propped up on a pillow and had a blanket.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Wash Infant's Hands: During interviews of staff during the investigation inspection, staff stated that they are not washing the infants' hands after diaper changes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Wash Infant's Hands (26 TAC §746.3505(b))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes: During the investigation inspection on 4/27/2023, two infants were awake and seated in restrictive devices for more than 35 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §746.2417(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: Two of the four personnel files reviewed were missing proof that orientation was completed within the first seven days of their employment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Hitting with Hand or Instrument: This standard was tasked over as part of the investigation and was found to be deficient. Through interviews with the staff, it was determined a caregiver hit the back of an infant's head with their hand when the infant was biting another infant.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Hitting with Hand or Instrument (26 TAC §746.2805(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During the follow up inspeciton, one caregiver was with five infants aged 0-11 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: One child with a diagnosed food allergy did not have the signature of the health care professional on the food allergy emergency plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Thirteen of the fourteen infants in care were missing current feeding schedules.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: In an infant room, one caregiver was with five infants aged 0-11 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: During the follow up inspection, three cribs in an infant classroom had loosely fitted sheets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Infants Sleep on Backs or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant: During the inspection, a caregiver was observed placing a two months-old infant on their stomach to sleep.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Infants Sleep on Backs or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant (26 TAC §746.2427)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: During an investigation inspection on 8/11/22 by DFPS, the investigator observed that two cribs in an infant classroom had loosely fitted sheets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: During an investigation inspection on 8/11/22 by DFPS, the investigator observed that an infant caregiver did not use the safety straps on the seats at a table for five infants who were having lunch at the table.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Caregiver's Hands Washed: During an investigation inspection on 8/11/22 by DFPS, the investigator observed that an infant caregiver did not wash their hands after changing diapers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Caregiver's Hands Washed (26 TAC §746.3505(a))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Wash Infant's Hands: During an investigation inspection on 8/11/22 by DFPS, the investigator observed that an infant caregiver did not wash the infants? hands after changing their diapers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Wash Infant's Hands (26 TAC §746.3505(b))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area: During an investigation inspection on 8/11/22 by DFPS, the investigator observed that an infant caregiver did not use a disposable sheet between diaper changes and did not clean the changing area after each diaper change.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3505(e))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: During an investigation inspection on 8/11/22 by DFPS, it was discovered that the operation was made aware of an incident that occurred which placed a child at risk but failed to report the incident to Child Care Regulation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Release of Children: This standard was evaluated as part on an investigation and was found to be deficient. A staff member working at the front desk and the caregiver in a classroom did not check the identification of a person picking up a child from the operation and did not verify if the person had permission to pick up the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Release of Children (26 TAC §746.4101)

occurrences.finding: Policies for Release of Children Instruct Employees of Verification Plan: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation and was found to be deficient.  During interviews with staff, an employee working at the front desk stated she was not informed of the child-care center's policies for the release of children, including the verification plan. The employee did not have written proof showing that they were informed of the release policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies for Release of Children Instruct Employees of Verification Plan (26 TAC §746.4103(c))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: This standard was found to be deficient after it was determined that a caregiver swung her leg and hit a child's leg above their ankle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)
